notes: Updates: every step, exercise and quiz has a fingerprint; the app remembers which version you finished
Updates: new modules and steps join your plan; a step you finished whose content changed goes back to not done, tagged Updated, with your earlier completion, quiz score and code kept in an archive
Today: a one-line 'What is new' note (See for the list, Got it to clear); Path cards tagged New or Updated
First run on an existing install records your progress as the starting point, and announces the new AI data stack modules (A4, A5)
Week strip: days before you began say so instead of a dash
Tests: new user, upgrade, changed step, changed exercise and quiz, iPhone layout; simulated users check past days are labelled
